name: Vale
greeting: A woman asked me to keep her statement, but not her address. Fold that leaf inward. The account stays readable; her door stays her own.
lines: Kael: An omission in a truthful record.
Vale: A boundary supplied by its subject. I used to confuse those with omissions supplied by a lord.
Kael: Does she know the difference?
Vale: She made me read it back. Twice.

variants.greeting: You wrote that you would ask whose safety a page changes. Here is someone who answered: keep her account, not her address.
Your letter asked who decides. In this case, the woman whose account it is. She asked me to keep her words, but not her address.

actions.label: Fold the private address inward; keep the statement open.

relationship_event.text: Kael helped preserve a living witness's private address without hiding her account.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: That folded leaf still keeps the account readable. You understood what she was asking.

actions.label: I still worry about who can demand an omission. Leave it with her instructions.

relationship_event.text: Kael questioned omissions while leaving the witness's own instructions intact.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: Your question belongs in this room. So does her right to answer it.

actions.label: This is between her and you. I won't handle it.

relationship_event.text: Kael declined to handle the private leaf. Vale preserved it as instructed.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I kept her instructions. You weren't obliged to take that work from me.
